Type 2 assignments: Carrying out some or all of the HI technical assistance/consultancy to a
mainstream organization/service/policy to be more accessible to people with disabilities.
Example: training of a general services and IT team on the challenges of digital accessibility in
companies, as part of a "Inclusive Employment" technical assistance/consultancy agreement
signed with the company.

Type 3 missions : Support to HI internal knowledge management on Accessibility
Example: Elaboration of a capitalization document on the issue of accessibility of urban
transport means, based on several experiences carried out by HI

II. Conditions of the call for expressions of interest

III. Eligibility

Any individual or group of individuals:
 Having a legal recognition of his consulting practices, and being up to date with his social
contributions in his country of professional registration
 Having a recognized expertise in the field of disability and inclusion
 Not having had a negotiated breach of contract with HI in the last 2 years, as of the date of
this call for expressions of interest.

IV. The framework contract

This call for expressions of interest aims to allow the multi-year contracting of international
consultants in the field of disability and inclusion.

A 3-year framework contract will be signed with each selected consultant, in which the
administrative and financial conditions of solicitation of each signatory consultant will be set out.

These solicitations will be made by means of an order form.
The signing consultant commits to financial conditions, which will be indexed annually to the SYNTEX
index, and which will be the subject of an amendment signed each year.
The consultants undertake to provide proof of any administrative and legal changes that may occur
during the term of the contract.

HI undertakes to give priority to consultants who have signed this framework contract with HI, for
any consultancy falling within the scope of this call for expression of interest.

However, neither the consultant nor HI commit to exclusivity or to an obligation of collaboration
during these 3 years.
III. Desired expertise

In particular in the following fields of intervention:

 Accessibility of buildings, infrastructures and urban spaces
 Accessibility in emergency contexts (shelter, WASH, refugee camps, etc.)
 Digital accessibility, websites, mobile applications, files and ICT in general
 Accessibility of mobility solutions and means of transport
 Accessibility of early warning systems (in the field of Disaster Risk Reduction)
